section_summary.extract_value: This section (3.2.2) presents factor analysis results for a male subsample (n = 165). The analysis demonstrates adequate factorability (KMO = .95, Bartlett's test p < .001), with a single factor explaining 70.8% of variance and factor loadings ranging from .80 to .90. Internal consistency was strong (Cronbach's α = .96), suggesting a reliable measurement instrument for this male sample.
